name: Citadel Render Continuity Rules
purpose: Visual reference assets and descriptive continuity metadata improve continuity, but topology, compass bearings, room definitions, exterior definitions, door locations, door count, direct adjacency, and non-adjacency always take precedence.

panorama360CompassNormalizationRule.capturePoint: true geometric center unless user explicitly requests otherwise
panorama360CompassNormalizationRule.noOverlayRule: Compass normalization must be achieved through composition, not visible compass labels, arrows, UI overlays, or explanatory text.
panorama360CompassNormalizationRule.garden360: Entry Hall doorway on east wall should appear around right-quarter position; northwest Buddha between left-quarter West and center North.
panorama360CompassNormalizationRule.hallOfDiscovery360: Astronomy center North, Logic right-quarter East, Biology left-quarter West, Science Door to Great Hall at far-left/far-right South seam.

workflowRules.panorama360: Compile prompt, checklist, approval, generation, audit, compliance score, findings, corrections, save path.
workflowRules.exteriorReference: Use Exterior Index as controlling source; preserve structural rules, southwest bridge and landing platform, Garden west of Entry Hall exterior mass, unified no-hallway structure.
workflowRules.doorRender: Identify source room, source door, destination room, destination door, compass wall, and preserve immediate doorway continuity.

promotionRule: Generated images are not canonical merely because generated. Promotion requires audit, user approval, save to correct GitHub path, and Image Reference Index record.
conflictHandling: Textual Codex topology, exterior rules, door-count rules, and compass normalization rules win over visual references.
